name: storefront-sample-static-vanilla-js
description: Single-Venue Storefront, Booking & Get Directions Hub built with Static HTML, Vanilla ES Modules, and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{for(const f of['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f)}})"
